newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Vice Chairman Eric Hilton retires.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Vice Chairman Eric Hilton retires.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Monday said Eric Hilton will retire as Vice Chairman of the company, effective immediately.

Hilton will remain a member of the board of directors, and he will serve as Hilton's representative to the International Rivercenter Corp Joint Venture in New Orleans, Louisiana, operators of the New Orleans Hilton Riverside Hotel.

"His accomplishments in the areas of domestic and international strategic planning and property development have been important to the continued growth of the company our father, Conrad N. Hilton, founded more than 75 years ago," Chairman Barron Hilton said in a statement.

Hilton was named vice chairman of Hilton Hotels Corporation in 1993 after serving as executive vice president and director of the company and as president and director of Conrad International, Hilton's chain of international hotels.

He first joined Conrad International as senior vice president - development in 1983, and was elected executive vice president in 1986. Prior to joining Conrad International, Hilton had served as senior vice president of Hilton's franchise division, Hilton Inns Inc.
